title: Three Men in Suits, 1950s Alabama Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from around 1950 depicting three men dressed in formal suits standing in a basement or fraternity room with exposed pipes along the ceiling. A small University of Alabama pennant and a sign reading 'BEER' are posted on the wall. The back features a Kodak Velox paper watermark and a stamped tracking number '1375'.
